entries.back_en: "Wait...Thou also art one of the Eternal...?"
entries.note: 'Eternos' renders 'The Endless' (canonical PT is 'Perpétuos', but acceptable); sense preserved.

entries.back_en: "No matter! No one, not even if he were brother to my master, may be allowed to enter!"
Standing in front of a switch lights up the floor. Press ~ to move a cube forward, and [7F] to move it back. Line up three blocks of the same color to create a path.
Do you want to go up?
